Masarikova’s displayed free spaces changed from 2 to 376, but the missing measurement time still prevents joining that change to those receptions [F6].
hypotheses_sr: Promena u Masarikovoj možda je lokalizovana na prikazani parking zapis, a ne dokaz prostorne promene u celom gradu, jer vreme merenja nije dostupno [F6].
